title: Sparkly slice of pizza
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow behind pizza -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="35" ry="30" fill="#1a1a2e" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- pizza crust -->
  <path d="M30 20 L70 20 L50 85 Z" fill="#e8a830" stroke="#f5c842" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- pizza sauce area -->
  <path d="M34 27 L66 27 L50 78 Z" fill="#d94a2a"/>

  <!-- cheese layer -->
  <path d="M36 31 L64 31 L50 74 Z" fill="#f5d76e"/>

  <!-- cheese highlight -->
  <path d="M40 36 L60 36 L50 68 Z" fill="#f9e79f" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- pepperoni 1 -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="42" r="5" fill="#c0392b"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="42" r="3" fill="#e74c3c"/>

  <!-- pepperoni 2 -->
  <circle cx="55" cy="52" r="4.5" fill="#c0392b"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="52" r="2.8" fill="#e74c3c"/>

  <!-- pepperoni 3 -->
  <circle cx="47" cy="60" r="4" fill="#c0392b"/>
  <circle cx="47" cy="60" r="2.5" fill="#e74c3c"/>

  <!-- pepperoni 4 -->
  <circle cx="52" cy="38" r="3.5" fill="#c0392b"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="38" r="2" fill="#e74c3c"/>

  <!-- crust edge highlight -->
  <path d="M30 20 L70 20 L68 23 L32 23 Z" fill="#f5c842"/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <!-- sparkle top left -->
  <g transform="translate(18, 18)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-6" x2="0" y2="6" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-6" y1="0" x2="6" y2="0" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-4" y1="-4" x2="4" y2="4" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="4" y1="-4" x2="-4" y2="4" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle top right -->
  <g transform="translate(82, 22)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-5" x2="0" y2="5" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="0" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-3.5" y1="-3.5" x2="3.5" y2="3.5" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="3.5" y1="-3.5" x2="-3.5" y2="3.5" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle left -->
  <g transform="translate(15, 55)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-4" x2="0" y2="4" stroke="#fff5b8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-4" y1="0" x2="4" y2="0" stroke="#fff5b8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-2.8" y1="-2.8" x2="2.8" y2="2.8" stroke="#fff5b8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="2.8" y1="-2.8" x2="-2.8" y2="2.8" stroke="#fff5b8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle right -->
  <g transform="translate(85, 58)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-4" x2="0" y2="4" stroke="#fff5b8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-4" y1="0" x2="4" y2="0" stroke="#fff5b8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-2.8" y1="-2.8" x2="2.8" y2="2.8" stroke="#fff5b8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="2.8" y1="-2.8" x2="-2.8" y2="2.8" stroke="#fff5b8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle bottom -->
  <g transform="translate(30, 88)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-3.5" x2="0" y2="3.5" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-3.5" y1="0" x2="3.5" y2="0" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-2.5" y1="-2.5" x2="2.5" y2="2.5" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="2.5" y1="-2.5" x2="-2.5" y2="2.5" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- tiny sparkle bottom right -->
  <g transform="translate(72, 84)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-2.5" x2="0" y2="2.5" stroke="#fff5b8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-2.5" y1="0" x2="2.5" y2="0" stroke="#fff5b8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
</svg>
